name: TT Circuit Assen
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Grand Prix motorcycle course (2010 to date): OSM way 359172905 'TT Circuit' with the Ruskenhoek chicane bypassed by way 146537706, as the bike course diverts to avoid the chicane that is kept for four-wheel events
metadata.official_length_source: https://www.motogp.com/en/calendar/2026/event/netherlands/47c25c37-d307-4d45-b1ed-b1cb5e811975 (4.54 km; 4542 m in the MotoGP timing sheets, e.g. https://resources.motogp.com/files/results/2024/NED/MotoGP/SPR/Grid.pdf)

start_finish.source: Start line at the front of the painted grid (transverse white line ahead of the grid slots on the pit straight), identified in the Beeldmateriaal Nederland 2026 ortho (PDOK)

width.status: Measured from orthoimagery pavement colour; median 27 m and Gaussian 6 m smoothed; gaps interpolated

elevation.name: AHN DTM 0.5 m (PDOK WCS coverage dtm_05m, requested at 1 m)
elevation.bank: DEM cross slope between the measured edges, median and Gaussian smoothed, clamped to 8 degrees

imagery.name: Beeldmateriaal Nederland luchtfoto 2026 ortho 8 cm RGB (PDOK WMS layer 2026_orthoHR)

metadata.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL) for OSM derived geometry, separate from repository MIT source code
metadata.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; Beeldmateriaal Nederland / PDOK; AHN / PDOK
limitations: Centerline is OSM geometry recentred on imaged pavement, not a survey
Kerb positions come from imagery colour; kerb height reuses Thunderhill's provisional profile
Grip, run-off surfaces, walls and barriers are not modelled
